scope: Primary measurement and embedded-EMC omission challenge for frozen six-ADC-antigen exploratory pilot; bounded source review, no claim of exhaustive evaluated literature

sources.conditions: All six male metastatic EMC patients; five RNA-QC passing observations, one inadequate RNA with prior archival EWSR1-NR4A3 FISH. Fresh metastatic biopsy5, archived metastatic sample1.
sources.measurement: Original main text and abstract report FOLR1 outlier overexpression in two of five RNA-evaluable patients. Case IDs and numerical values not recovered from the unassessed supplement.
sources.interpretation: Published RNA heterogeneity/outlier hypothesis and folate-targeting suggestion are prior art. No protein, accessible surface epitope, ADC efficacy or poor-RNA absence inference.
sources.overlap: Donor overlap with other expression cohorts unresolved.

sources.conditions: One author-labelled extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma among22 other-cancer enrollment observations;60 enrolled59 treated overall. Main text does not link the pre-dose dropout to histology.
sources.measurement: Main text and Fig3 legend verified; figure describes Ex-labelled case-level central HER2/response data. Individual EMC IHC score, mutation, treatment status and response unextracted. Ordinary figure/bin404 retained.
sources.interpretation: Existing EMC trial enrollment must not be omitted. No EMC benefit/failure estimate or molecular authentication inferred from aggregate response counts.
sources.overlap: Unknown donor overlap with all other cohorts; main text supplies no NR4A3 confirmation.

sources.conditions: One45-year-old woman, index breast tumor; review TableIa includes21 author-labelled cases, six rows explicitly HER2-negative.
sources.measurement: Index HER2/neu negative; unspecified IHC score, membrane extent and clone. EWSR1 FISH35%split, without demonstrated NR4A3 fusion partner.
sources.interpretation: A measured negative index case with incomplete canonical authentication; do not assign21 negative measurements or calculate authenticated EMC sensitivity.
sources.overlap: Review references are not separate molecular validations; duplicate reporting and identity unresolved.

sources.conditions: One41-year-old woman, vacuum-assisted breast core biopsy; included as review row3.
sources.measurement: Original reports HER2 negativity and focal pankeratin positivity; author-labelled extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma. No EWSR1/NR4A3 evidence found in original main text.
sources.interpretation: Preserve reported negative measurement as identity-unresolved; no molecularly authenticated EMC denominator.
sources.overlap: Same case as breast review row3, not independent validation.

sources.conditions: One45-year-old woman, metaplastic breast carcinoma with predominant chondrosarcoma; misincluded as breast review row13.
sources.measurement: Original c-erbB2 negative. Cytokeratin/EMA-positive epithelial component and final primary diagnosis explicitly metaplastic carcinoma.
sources.interpretation: Useful mimic control; unsuitable as authenticated EMC HER2-negative measurement. Preserve the review discrepancy without external correction.
sources.overlap: Same case as breast review row13.

sources.conditions: 20 localized soft-tissue sarcoma participants, including one grade2 EMC in eight grade2 tumors; blood microvesicles pre/post surgery,18 pooled post-R0 participants.
sources.measurement: CD142-positive circulating plasma microvesicles measured, alongside platelet/AnnexinV phenotypes. Case-linked EMC pre/post values not exposed in inspected main text.
sources.interpretation: Measured F3-related circulating compartment, not EMC tumor-cell accessible tissue factor protein. No tumor-localization inference or individual EMC effect estimate.
sources.overlap: Single EMC clinical donor; all linked numerical conditions remain unavailable in main text.

sources.conditions: Table2 lists three extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma patients in the phase-I ultrarare sarcoma population.
sources.measurement: Main source table evaluated. Individual ADC exposure, antigen measurement, molecular authentication and response linkage unresolved; supplement tables not assessed.
sources.interpretation: Broader clinical source containing EMC; not proof of ADC treatment or absence.
sources.overlap: Possible overlap with SAMBA101 at same center; do not sum as independent cases.

sources.conditions: 75 first-line experimental patients explicitly include one EMC. Full587 cohort Table1 reports four extraskeletal chondrosarcomas, lacking a myxoid-specific individual crosswalk.
sources.measurement: Main text and baseline table evaluated; drug class/ADC response cannot be linked to EMC from inspected aggregate figures.
sources.interpretation: First-line EMC is identifiable, broader generic four-case label must not silently be called authenticated EMC. Individual antigen/clinical endpoints remain unresolved.
sources.overlap: Possible overlap with SAMBA102; repeated trial enrollments also reported.

sources.conditions: 115 soft-tissue sarcomas in primary abstract; candidate returned by EMC fulltext-index query, but EMC membership/individual count unresolved.
sources.measurement: Aggregate c-Met IHC/ISH abstract evaluated; EPMC XML500 and official BioC returned nonarticle error payload.
sources.interpretation: Do not transfer87%aggregate sarcoma positivity to EMC. Primary EMC eligibility and localized antigen staining pending source access.

sources.conditions: 102 benign/malignant musculoskeletal tumors in primary abstract; EMC eligibility unresolved.
sources.measurement: Western/IHC and truncated intracellular Met fragment reported in aggregate; EPMC XML500, BioC nonarticle/error payload.
sources.interpretation: Full-length surface and intracellular truncated fragments cannot be conflated. No EMC inference from musculoskeletal aggregate.

sources.source: Other breast review measured HER2 rows2/8/15: Cong2018,Errahay2013,Gurleyik2009
sources.conditions: Three source-reported HER2-negative rows; original molecular identity and assay details unresolved.
sources.measurement: Review TableIa only; Gurleyik primary XML access500 retained in source-cache/breast-primary-contexts.json.
sources.interpretation: No authenticated EMC negative denominator; original reports remain review candidates.
sources.overlap: Already included in21-row review, not new donors.

unassessed_catalogue: Primary-search metadata catalogue contains128 unique rows across seven target/ADC queries (NECTIN4 query zero indexed hits). Discovery/title inspection is not full-source evaluation. Relevant unresolved sources retain pending/unavailable status; missing EMC-linked values are never zeros.
decision_consequence: No standalone finding can advance from these sources. Failed prospective panel permits shelving while pending relevant evidence remains visible; future positive or broader negative claims require completing eligible sources.
